profile.title: Software Engineering Student | Aspiring AI Engineer | Full-Stack Developer
profile.statement: I build intelligent digital experiences and explore how technology and Artificial Intelligence can solve real-world problems.
profile.summary: I'm a Software Engineering student at Jimma University, passionate about Artificial Intelligence, software development, and building innovative solutions that address real-world challenges.
profile.biography: I'm studying Software Engineering at Jimma University in Ethiopia. What draws me in is the path from a problem to a working idea: learning the tools, shaping the approach, and building software that can be used. Artificial Intelligence is the field I most want to grow into, because it offers a way to design systems that respond to real situations. I use software projects as practice in design, development, and problem solving. My aim is to build intelligent systems that matter beyond the screen, and I treat learning as part of the work.
profile.mission: My goal is to transform ideas into meaningful technology and use Artificial Intelligence to create solutions that make a difference.
profile.currentFocus: Software engineering studies, with time set aside for Artificial Intelligence, full-stack development, and turning ideas into working software.
profile.careerGoal: To become an AI engineer and full-stack developer who builds intelligent systems that help with real problems.
